fr-FR.name: Frida
fr-FR.summary: Pilotez votre maison à la voix grâce aux interactions de votre Jeedom.
fr-FR.description: Ce skill envoie vos phrases aux interactions de votre serveur Jeedom et lit la réponse. Sur un Echo Show, il ouvre aussi votre dashboard Jeedom.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ouvre assistant frida
Allume la lumière de la cuisine
Quelle est la température du salon

en-US.name: Frida
en-US.summary: Control your home by voice through your Jeedom interactions.
en-US.description: This skill sends your sentences to the interactions of your Jeedom server and reads the answer aloud. On an Echo Show it can also open your Jeedom dashboard.
examplePhrases: Alexa, open frida assistant
Turn on the kitchen light
What is the living room temperature

de-DE.name: Frida
de-DE.summary: Steuere dein Zuhause per Sprache über die Interaktionen deines Jeedom.
de-DE.description: Dieser Skill sendet deine Sätze an die Interaktionen deines Jeedom-Servers und liest die Antwort vor. Auf einem Echo Show öffnet er auch dein Jeedom-Dashboard.
examplePhrases: Alexa, öffne frida assistent

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Fill lambda/config.cfg with a reachable Jeedom URL and API key, then say: open frida assistant.
